ddpl-3-0.pathwayTitle: Knockout Pathway: Dual Group Stage ➔ Semi-Finals ➔ Grand Final

stages.title: Stage 1: Multi-Pool League
stages.desc: Franchises compete in Group A & Group B. Top 2 teams from each pool advance to the Cross-Group Playoffs.

stages.title: Stage 2: Cross-Group Semi-Finals
stages.desc: Pool A Leader vs Pool B Runner-Up, and Pool B Leader vs Pool A Runner-Up clash for a place in the Grand Final.

stages.title: Stage 3: Grand Final
stages.desc: The two victorious semi-finalists face off in the Grand Final for the official corporate tournament trophy!

ddpl-3-0.qualificationRule: Top 2 teams from each pool advance to the Cross-Group Semi-Finals.
